contentPattern.structure: image + date eyebrow + title + short copy (article link)

suitableFor: large uniform grids of dated article cards
press release archives and 'latest news' feeds
notSuitableFor: mixed-prominence promotional mosaics with a feature callout (use cards-news)
colored quick-link navigation tiles with title overlays (use cards-quicklinks)

notes: Uniform news-card grid variant. First paragraph in each card body is styled as an uppercase date eyebrow. Filter controls (Type/Location/Topic) on the source are progressive enhancement over a plain cards list; the authored content model is a standard cards list. Also reused for the article-page 'Related' band (c28-related-card-grid): the slick slider is progressive enhancement over the same uniform image+date+title+copy card model.
